purpose: Test whether a stock-specific information-diffusion process has begun when daily returns relative to PIT industry peers change from nonpositive rank serial dependence during the preceding two months to positive rank serial dependence during the latest month, with a positive current residual return fixing the long direction.
economic_mechanism: Public or private information may be incorporated gradually. A fresh switch from mean-reverting or uncorrelated industry-residual returns to persistent positive residual returns is a temporal mechanism, not merely high cumulative momentum.

novelty_boundary.new_claim: The predictor is the sign change in nonoverlapping lag-one serial dependence of daily PIT-industry residual returns.
not_equivalent_to: industry diffusion, industry momentum, or leader-follower ranking
breakout, support, gap, VWAP, low-risk, or low-skewness rules
novelty_boundary.current_residual_direction_role: The strictly positive decision-session residual fixes the economically intended good-news direction without adding a residual-momentum path condition; it is not the ranked score.

required: positive finite OHLC, preclose, amount, and turnover

representation.daily_stock_return: close / preclose - 1 on a completed eligible daily row
representation.daily_industry_reference: exact leave-one-out median daily stock return among eligible members of the same PIT industry and date
representation.recent_serial_dependence: lag-one Spearman correlation of daily_residual_return over exactly the latest 20 contiguous market-session pairs ending at the decision close
representation.prior_serial_dependence: lag-one Spearman correlation over exactly the nonoverlapping preceding 40 contiguous market-session pairs
representation.positive_current_residual: daily_residual_return on the completed decision session is strictly positive
representation.exact_history: The prior 40 pairs and recent 20 pairs share only their boundary endpoint, so exactly 60 lag-one pairs and 61 residual endpoint rows are required. All endpoint rows must be contiguous global market sessions; every pair window must be nondegenerate. A suspension, missing/invalid row, absent industry reference, or nonfinite value fails closed.
representation.timing: Every component ends at the completed month-end close and is available no later than that decision_at.

mother_event.decision_schedule: last completed market session of each calendar month
conditions: signal-day amount is at least the same-date eligible-universe median
mother_event.selection: Within each PIT industry and decision date, retain exactly the stock with the largest serial_phase_change; break ties by larger amount and then lexical symbol.
mother_event.cooldown: After ranking, reject a repeated symbol whose local market-session index is no more than 20 after its last retained event.

outcome_blind_stage_a_gates.if_failed: Close V31 before constructing or reading any post-signal row.

future_stage_b_if_stage_a_passes.entry: first legal non-upper-limit open in market sessions signal plus one through plus three
future_stage_b_if_stage_a_passes.target: 10 percent gross above the executable entry coordinate
future_stage_b_if_stage_a_passes.fallback: on the first legal sellable open strictly after entry plus 20 market sessions, with the open evaluated before any same-session high

future_visual_review_if_stage_a_passes.window: 126 global market sessions before through 126 after every frozen signal

readiness_probe_disclosure.prototype_definition: A nonbinding implementation probe used Pearson serial dependence and positive latest-20 residual path. It was superseded before any outcome read after an adversarial semantic review identified thick-tail sensitivity and residual-momentum contamination.
readiness_probe_disclosure.purpose: The prior probe established only that the broad residual phase-change family was computationally feasible. The frozen Spearman/current-residual definition must pass its own one-time outcome-blind gates; no outcome may be attached if it fails.

prohibited: autocorrelation magnitude thresholds other than the frozen zero crossings
alternative residual definitions, Pearson rescue, or nonlinear transformations
Top-N, holding-period, target, market-regime, or execution grids
2021 or 2022-2024 read before the written gates
portfolio replay before a visually compressed rule earns it
